definitions.explanation: The rod or spindle that passes through the center of a wheel, allowing it to rotate. Used for vehicles, machinery, and other wheeled equipment.

examples.japanese: {車軸|しゃじく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{折|お}れた→折れる：01266_oreru⟧。
{車軸|しゃじく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}して→差す：17637_sasu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{動|うご}かして→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please oil the axle before operating it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{荷車|にぐるま}→荷車：14242_niguruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{車軸|しゃじく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きしむ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な{田舎道|いなかみち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{響|ひび}いていた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: The creaking sound of an old cart's axle echoed along the quiet country road.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (wheel, vehicle) and ⟦{軸|じく}→軸：14304_jiku⟧ (axis, shaft). Also appears in the vivid weather expression {車軸|しゃじく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧, meaning a torrential downpour so heavy it could wash away an axle — an evocative way to describe extremely heavy rain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車軸|しゃじく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{折|お}れる→折れる：01266_oreru⟧: the axle breaks
- {車軸|しゃじく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧: to oil the axle
- {車軸|しゃじく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧: torrential rain (idiomatic)
- ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧{車軸|しゃじく}: front axle
- {後|うしろ}{車軸|しゃじく}: rear axle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{軸|じく}→軸：14304_jiku⟧: axis; shaft — the general term for any central rod or axis
- ⟦{車輪|しゃりん}→車輪：04198_sharin⟧: wheel — the circular part that rotates around the axle
- {枢軸|すうじく}: pivot; axis — used figuratively (e.g., {枢軸国|すうじくこく}, Axis powers)
